title: Saluting veteran at a Veterans Day parade
summary: A video of a scarred veteran being saluted at a parade was shared as real. Lead Stories found it was made with AI.
tell: Drumsticks vanish, medals melt into the uniform and the flag's stripes change width.

title: Colosseum and Eiffel Tower lit blue for the midterms
summary: Photos claimed the Colosseum and Eiffel Tower were lit blue for Democratic midterm wins. Lead Stories found they were made with AI.
tell: Neither landmark's own website or social media showed any such lighting.

title: Pennsylvania voter registration "scheme" video
summary: A post said a video proved 2026 voter registration fraud in Pennsylvania. Lead Stories found it was a 2024 press conference about the previous election.
tell: Check when a video was first posted. Old clips with new captions are a common trick.

title: Sharp photo of the Florida jet crash
summary: A crisp photo of the Florida jet crash seemed to show a missing wing. Lead Stories found it was apparently dashcam video "cleaned up" with AI.
tell: It looked sharper than any real footage, and the real video shows both wings.

title: Florida jet crash video is real, not AI
summary: A post claimed dashcam video of the Florida jet crash was "100%" AI. PolitiFact found it was real and confirmed by major news outlets.
tell: Calling something "AI" can be false too. Check whether trusted news outlets confirmed it.
